title: Pasta salad with tuna, rocket and tomatoes
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente, rinse in cold water and drain.
Halve the tomatoes, finely chop the onion and drain the tuna.
Whisk the lemon juice, oil, salt and pepper.
Toss the pasta with the tuna, tomatoes, onion, olives, rocket, basil and dressing.
